# Vendored: cm-chessboard 8.7.2 Staunty pieces

Source: [cm-chessboard@8.7.2](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cm-chessboard/v/8.7.2)
(`assets/pieces/staunty.svg` — same version the Playground board loads from CDN).

Piece set origin: [lila Staunty](https://github.com/ornicar/lila/tree/master/public/piece/staunty),
adapted by shaack for cm-chessboard.

**License (piece artwork):** [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)
(as stated in the SVG header). cm-chessboard library code is MIT; this folder vendors
only the Staunty SVG sprite (and pre-rasterized PNGs under `chess_harness/assets/staunty/`
derived from it for Pillow board rendering).

Do not upgrade this sprite without matching Playground’s `CM_CHESSBOARD_VERSION` / CDN pin.
